evidence.why: Integer writer, exclusion guard and direct getter.
Checked player-record selection.
Shared healing reports one and subsequently clamps damage.
Explicit PSI Magnet hook calculates and bounds the healing contribution.
Getter result stored in x48.

Shared healing reports one per decrement; Ness's documented PSI Magnet hook adjusts the heal when damage would become negative before passing it through the integer parameter. Finalization copies the total to x48. These facts describe recorded contributions, not a guarantee of exact fractional healing: shared healing clamps after reporting, and the Ness argument can undergo integer conversion.
